import bpy
import bmesh
import math
from mathutils import Vector

def clear_scene():
    """Removes all default objects from the scene."""
    bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
    bpy.ops.object.delete()

def create_material(name, color):
    """Creates a simple Principled BSDF material."""
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name=name)
    mat.use_nodes = True
    nodes = mat.node_tree.nodes
    nodes.clear()
    
    node_principled = nodes.new(type='ShaderNodeBsdfPrincipled')
    node_output = nodes.new(type='ShaderNodeOutputMaterial')
    
    node_principled.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = color
    # Make the fish body matte as requested
    node_principled.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = 0.8
    
    mat.node_tree.links.new(node_principled.outputs['BSDF'], node_output.inputs['Surface'])
    return mat

def create_fin_geometry(name, width, height, rays_count=12, color_mat=None):
    """
    Creates a fin consisting of multiple 'ribs' (rays) 
    to give it geometric detail rather than just a flat plane.
    """
    mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, mesh)
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(obj)
    
    bm = bmesh.new()
    
    # Create a series of narrow strips to simulate fin rays
    ray_width = width / (rays_count * 2)
    for i in range(rays_count):
        x_offset = (i - (rays_count - 1) / 2) * (width / rays_count)
        
        # Create a ray as a thin box/plate
        v1 = bm.verts.new(Vector((x_offset - ray_width/2, 0, 0)))
        v2 = bm.verts.new(Vector((x_offset + ray_width/2, 0, 0)))
        v3 = bm.verts.new(Vector((x_offset + ray_width/2, 0, height)))
        v4 = bm.verts.new(Vector((x_offset - ray_width/2, 0, height)))
        
        bm.faces.new((v1, v2, v3, v4))
        
    bm.to_mesh(mesh)
    bm.free()
    
    if color_mat:
        obj.data.materials.append(color_mat)
        
    return obj

def create_fish():
    # Materials
    periwinkle = create_material("Periwinkle", (0.6, 0.7, 0.9, 1.0)) # Blue-gray
    gold_brown = create_material("GoldBrown", (0.6, 0.4, 0.2, 1.0))  # Golden brown
    black = create_material("Black", (0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 1.0))

    # --- Body Construction ---
    # Start with a UV Sphere and deform it into an oval laterally compressed shape
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(radius=1, location=(0, 0, 0), segments=32, ring_count=16)
    body = bpy.context.active_object
    body.name = "FishBody"
    
    # Scale to fish proportions: X (width/compressed), Y (length), Z (height)
    body.scale = (0.3, 2.0, 1.0)
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False, rotation=False, scale=True)
    
    # Use BMesh to refine the head and tail shapes
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bm.from_mesh(body.data)
    
    # Taper the front (head) and back (tail)
    for v in bm.verts:
        # Move vertices based on Y position
        if v.co.y > 0: # Head side
            # Point the snout slightly
            v.co.x *= (1.0 - (v.co.y * 0.2))
            v.co.z *= (1.0 - (v.co.y * 0.1))
        elif v.co.y < 0: # Tail side
            # Narrow the body towards the caudal peduncle
            taper = 1.0 + (v.co.y * 0.3) # Y is negative, so this shrinks x and z
            v.co.x *= taper
            v.co.z *= taper

    bm.to_mesh(body.data)
    bm.free()
    
    # Smooth shading
    for poly in body.data.polygons:
        poly.use_smooth = True
        
    body.data.materials.append(periwinkle)

    # --- Eyes ---
    def add_eye(side):
        bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(radius=0.1, location=(side * 0.25, 1.6, 0.3))
        eye = bpy.context.active_object
        eye.name = f"Eye_{'L' if side > 0 else 'R'}"
        eye.data.materials.append(black)
        eye.parent = body

    add_eye(1)  # Left eye (relative to fish facing +Y)
    add_eye(-1) # Right eye

    # --- Mouth ---
    # Create a small pointed protrusion at the tip
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bm.from_mesh(body.data)
    # Find vertices at the very front
    front_verts = [v for v in bm.verts if v.co.y > 1.9]
    for v in front_verts:
        v.co.y += 0.05 # Slight push out
        v.co.x *= 0.5  # Pinch to a point
    bm.to_mesh(body.data)
    bm.free()

    # --- Fins ---
    # Fin positioning and sizing (X, Y, Z)
    # Dorsal: Top center back
    dorsal = create_fin_geometry("DorsalFin", width=0.6, height=0.7, rays_count=15, color_mat=gold_brown)
    dorsal.location = (0, 0.2, 1.0)
    dorsal.rotation_euler = (0, 0, 0) # Facing up along Z
    dorsal.parent = body

    # Caudal: Tail
    caudal = create_fin_geometry("CaudalFin", width=0.8, height=1.2, rays_count=20, color_mat=gold_brown)
    caudal.location = (0, -2.0, 0)
    caudal.rotation_euler = (math.radians(90), 0, 0) # Rotate to face backward along Y
    caudal.parent = body

    # Pectorals: Sides
    for side in [1, -1]:
        pec = create_fin_geometry(f"PectoralFin_{'L' if side > 0 else 'R'}", width=0.5, height=0.6, rays_count=10, color_mat=gold_brown)
        # Position on sides
        pec.location = (side * 0.35, 0.8, 0)
        # Rotate to be perpendicular to body
        pec.rotation_euler = (math.radians(90), 0, math.radians(90 if side > 0 else -90))
        pec.parent = body

    # Pelvics: Bottom front
    for side in [1, -1]:
        pel = create_fin_geometry(f"PelvicFin_{'L' if side > 0 else 'R'}", width=0.3, height=0.4, rays_count=8, color_mat=gold_brown)
        pel.location = (side * 0.2, 0.5, -0.8)
        pel.rotation_euler = (math.radians(90), 0, math.radians(90 if side > 0 else -90))
        pel.parent = body

    # Anal: Bottom rear
    anal = create_fin_geometry("AnalFin", width=0.4, height=0.5, rays_count=12, color_mat=gold_brown)
    anal.location = (0, -0.6, -1.0)
    anal.rotation_euler = (0, math.radians(180), 0) # Pointing down
    anal.parent = body

if __name__ == "__main__":
    clear_scene()
    create_fish()
